bg-background.usage: Tier-0 canvas; deep near-black, hosts the two fixed ambient glows (primary ~7% top-left, secondary ~5% bottom-right, 600px blur). Product --st-background already matches.

bg-surface.usage: Base surface tier (spec lists M3 role set bg-surface / -bright / -dim as primary color vocabulary).

bg-surface-container-lowest.usage: THE glass recipe: bg-surface-container-lowest/70 + backdrop-blur-xl + 1px border-outline-variant/20 + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05). Used 21x in dashboard export.

bg-surface-container-low.usage: Tier-2 floating popovers & quick-settings (w-80 rounded-2xl bg-surface-container-low border shadow-2xl).

text-on-surface.usage: Primary text; 55 uses per dashboard export screen.

text-on-surface-variant.usage: Secondary/meta text; 64 uses across one screen.

border-outline-variant.usage: Hairline glass borders: border-outline-variant/20 resting, /50 fine-pointer hover, /15 list-row separators.

border-outline.usage: Stronger line; hover border-state (outline-variant/20 -> /50 via border-outline on hover per spec).

primary.value: #59d8c9 (DESIGN.md + product --st-primary; export CDN hex #78f5e5 is drift)
primary.usage: Single brand teal. Radial ambient glow, active states, key CTA + 0 0 24px primary/25 glow, 2px focus rings. NEVER purple --accent / #2563eb.

primary-container.usage: Container tint; active nav row = bg-primary-container + text-on-primary-container; bg-primary-container/10 selected tiles; TOTP focus ring-primary/50.

primary-container/10.usage: Tonality tint for selected direction tiles, stat bars, icons.

error.usage: Destructive + honest errors; error bubble bg-error-container/20 text-error; overdue chips border-error/30.

error-container.usage: Error inline strip: bg-error-container/15 border-error/30 rounded-xl p-3 text-error font-code-sm + Retry.

sem-amber.usage: Pending review, due today, demo ribbon, override dots, insufficient-tokens amber tile (bg-tertiary-container/10).

sem-blue.usage: In progress, active executions, New event bubbles.

chart-1..5.usage: RESTYLE ONLY - analytic area chart restyled via tokens (line var --chart-line-primary + 10%->0 gradient + --chart-grid + M3 tooltip); visx library NEVER swapped.

unit-6.value: 1.5rem = 24px (export spacing scale unit-3 .75 / unit-4 1 / unit-5 1.25 / unit-6 1.5 / unit-8 2 / unit-10 2.5 / unit-12 3rem; micro-1 .25 / micro-2 .5rem)
unit-6.usage: 8px-grid spacing used as p-unit-6, gap-unit-8, px-unit-6 in export markup. NOT registered in product (product uses p-4/p-6 + --spacing-xs..xl). Map or add alias.

gutter-mobile / gutter-desktop.usage: Page gutters: mobile margin 16px, desktop 32px page margin (spec) with 24px panel gutter in export.

page-max-width.usage: Global content cap; export class = max-w-page-max mx-auto; spec scaffold util page-max (kills 7 competing widths 1400/1248/1440/7xl/6xl/4xl). Product does NOT yet define .page-max/.page-pad.

shadow-glow-primary.usage: The singular focus glow on the one page-KEY CTA; spec bans rgba literals so implement via token.

rounded-3xl.usage: DESIGN.md shape language: panels/DialogShell/sheet tops/empty-state bounds. NOTE: exported screens only use up to rounded-xl (12px); apply 3xl/2xl when porting.

rounded-2xl.usage: DESIGN.md: analytic cards, quick-settings, auth cards, segmented modules. Also absent from export markup.

rounded-xl.usage: DESIGN.md: buttons, inputs, OTP cells, inline banners. The scale actually emitted by the export (35x in dashboard).

rounded-lg.usage: Chips, Kbd, metadata tokens (StatusChip recipe: rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 6px dot).

fonts: Hanken Grotesk (export: Google 'Hanken Grotesk' 600/700; product: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable' self-hosted) - display-xl 48/56/700 -0.02em (mobile 36), headline-lg 32/40/600
Inter (400/500/600) - title-md 20/28/600, body-md 16/24 (16px mandatory, iOS zoom), body-sm 14/20

JetBrains Mono (400/500/600, tabular tnum always) - label-caps 12/16/500 +.05em UPPER, tabular-stat 14 (all numbers/prices/tokens/timestamps; lg 30/36/600 used by export), code-sm 11 (product pin 13px - drift), chip-status 10/12/500 uppercase
design_system.fonts_note: Font/class names line up: product index.css @theme inline already registers --font-display-xl, --font-headline-lg, --font-title-md, --font-body-md/-sm, --font-label-caps, --font-tabular-stat, --font-code-sm with the same M3 role names and self-hosted variable families (policy: never Google CDN). Export-only names NOT in product: font-chip-status + text-chip-status (10px mono caps), font-tabular-stat-md/-lg + text-* variants, font-display-xl-mobile, headline-lg-mobile in some files. Exports pull Google Fonts CDN + Material Symbols Outlined - both must be dropped (product self-hosts; lucide-react only per spec $10). Minor value drift to reconcile: export code-sm 11px vs product 13px pin; export config primary #78f5e5 vs product --st-primary #59d8c9; spec + DESIGN.md both say 59d8c9, so product wins.
principles: Dark-first Luminous Glass: deep near-black canvas (bg-background #0e1113) + 2 fixed ambient radial glows (primary ~7% top-left, secondary ~5% bottom-right, 600px blur; light theme = soft teal glow at 40%); glass panels = lowest/70 + backdrop-blur-xl + border-outline-variant/20 + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05) (.04 light).

Light as accent: primary sparingly (typography accents, active states, one page-KEY CTA carrying the 0 0 24px primary/25 glow). One brand color, M3 teal ONLY - purple var(--accent) and blue #2563eb die.
Honest telemetry: JetBrains Mono tabular for every number (credits, tokens, scores, prices, timestamps, percentages) - the product signature; mono figures = identity, not decoration.

Zero fake reality: no AI-generated imagery, no emoji-as-icons, no demo data in live surfaces, no fabricated notifications/events/versions/results; every state honest (error + Retry instead of fake-empty, amber tile for HTTP-200 insufficient_tokens).

Strict M3 role tokens only: zero dark: variants, zero hex/rgba literals in components, theming via CSS vars + data-theme; ONE component per job (5-button set, StatusChip 11-map, DialogShell w/ focus trap, MobileSheet state machine, StickyBar A/B/C, ChipScroller).
One illustration family: curved-stroke line art (single accent color, no fills) for empties/heroes/success; lucide-react icons; the only bitmap = product logo.

Touch + a11y floor: everything interactive >=44x44 (48px bars), inputs >=44px & 16px text, pb-safe everywhere bottom-anchored, 2px primary focus ring :focus-visible, hover effects ONLY under (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) with no hover-only information, reduced-motion kills all animation.
Rhythm: header (display-xl + one-line sub) then action row then content; 24-32px gaps; max 2 card nesting levels; 8px grid; content capped at 1200px page-max.

export_quality.note: VERDICT: class-NAME compatibility is HIGH for colors/semantic-tokens/font-roles but NOT verbatim adoptable - the export is a self-contained Tailwind-CDN page (cdn.tailwindcss.com + Google Fonts + Material Symbols) with its own spacing/typography naming. M3 role classes emitted by the export (bg-surface-container-lowest/70, backdrop-blur-xl, border-outline-variant/20, text-on-surface(-variant), bg-sem-amber/15 text-sem-amber, font-label-caps, font-code-sm, text-label-caps, primary-container) match names the product's @theme inline already registers (--color-surface-container-lowest, --color-sem-amber, --font-label-caps ...), so an integrator can paste export class strings into JSX and they resolve against the product's per-theme vars - EXCEPT: export spacing scale unit-3..unit-12/micro-1/micro-2 + gutter-mobile/desktop + max-w-page-max (product: p-4/p-6, --spacing-xs..xl; .page-max/.page-pad don't exist yet); export font tokens font-chip-status, font-tabular-stat-md/lg (product: font-tabular-stat only); export radii stop at rounded-xl (DESIGN.md wants 3xl/2xl - apply during port); export uses arbitrary text-[18px]/text-[10px] + rgba shadow-arbitraries (spec bans literals); export has zero dark: variants (good) but also zero data-theme runtime (each file is one static theme baked via html class='dark' and inline hex config - light screens ship as <html class='dark'> too, so theming MUST come from product data-theme vars, never the export config). Screens carry no application JS and no a11y/state wiring - they are painted references; every interaction, state machine, aria-live/trap, skeleton/error/empty frame per spec $2.6-$2.7 is implementation work, not export content. Reusing export class strings + re-adding behavior is the intended path; do not ship the export files.

AvatarWidget spec (1.5) = rounded-full, avatarUrl when set else first letter.
asset_issues.fix: Replace with luminous-glass curved-stroke SVG line-art avatar: single accent teal stroke (#59d8c9, ~2-2.5px, stroke-linecap round), translucent 0.15 accent wash allowed as the only fill, optional 0 0 24px primary/25 halo, never fills/photo textures; style reference = helpotron_os_logo/code.html. Fallback = AvatarWidget first-letter.

asset_issues.issue: Export HTML references Stitch-hosted remote images (lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida/... , 66+46+36+ uses of 3 URL families) - HelpoTron logo and 'HelpoTron_logo (1).jpeg'; no local/base64 assets in the export at all.

asset_issues.path: code.html files - tailwind-config hex block + arbitrary values
asset_issues.issue: Each export bakes a dark-only hex token map (primary #78f5e5 vs product --st-primary #59d8c9 - DESIGN.md and spec say #59d8c9) and uses arbitrary classes: shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(120,245,229,0.25)], text-[18px] (11x), text-[10px], rgba glow literals (10-39 arbitrary classes/file). Spec 1.2 bans hex/rgba literals in components.
asset_issues.fix: Keep product --st-* var values (resolved per data-theme) as the only color source; express glows via token (0 0 24px primary/25); normalize arbitrary text sizes (product pins [7px..13px] via --fs-*).

asset_issues.issue: Export-only class names: font-chip-status/text-chip-status (10px mono caps), font-tabular-stat-md/-lg + text-* variants, font-display-xl-mobile, and spacing unit-3..unit-12/micro-1/micro-2/gutter-*/max-w-page-max. asset_issues.fix: Either add small token aliases (--font-chip-status, --text-chip-status, --spacing-unit-* mirrored to px scale, .page-max/.page-pad utilities per spec 2) or rename during port to existing product classes (font-label-caps, text-code-sm already cover label/mono use).

asset_issues.issue: Exports emit only rounded-sm/md/lg/xl/full; rounded-2xl (16px) and rounded-3xl (24px) are absent (0 uses in sampled 3.4.1/3.11.2/insights_analytics), yet DESIGN.md shape language and spec 1.4 call for rounded-3xl panels / rounded-2xl cards.

asset_issues.issue: Even the 'light' screens ship <html class="dark"> with the dark hex token map; no data-theme, and export has zero dark: variants (verified 0) but also zero runtime theming - palettes are baked per file.

asset_issues.issue: Export renders a static/stub chart SVG, not the product's visx pipeline; spec 10 contract = custom visx SVG pipeline restyled via tokens only, never swapped.

asset_issues.issue: Exports contain only the tailwind-config script (~121 files) plus one prefers-reduced-motion mention total; no JS behavior, no focus traps, no aria-live, no drag/snap sheets, no scroll states - state machines in spec 2.6 and checklist 2.7 are NOT drawn in the export (most screens ship only the populated 1440 + one mobile view; loading/error/empty frames for most (nothing for 3.7, 3.14, 3.21-3.23 mobile) are missing).
asset_issues.fix: Treat exports as visual grammar references; implement every state machine, trap, aria-live and the universal state checklist in the product components per spec 2.6-2.7 and 9-generation order.

avatar_fix: Spec guidance for the portrait: improvement.md 1.1 'One illustration family: curved-stroke line art (Stitch export style) for empties/heroes/success - drawn SVG paths, single accent color, no fills' + HARD RULE 'No AI-generated imagery' (1.2) + 10 'Icons: lucide-react only; illustrations = SVG line art; /HelpoTron_logo.jpeg the only bitmap' + DESIGN.md ('single-stroke accent paths without solid raster or gradient fills'; emoji prohibited in telemetry badges). So the photorealistic sophisticated_minimalist_student_portrait avatar must be replaced by a flat, glowing teal LINE-ART SVG avatar: single accent color (#59d8c9 M3 teal; optionally sem-green/green family), 2-2.5px stroke, stroke-linecap round, no fills beyond a ~0.15 alpha accent wash (as in helpotron_os_logo/code.html - the reference style in the export), small glow (0 0 24px primary/25 max), rendered rounded-full at 40-44px with 44px hit area. Functional contract (spec 1.5 AvatarWidget): show avatarUrl if the user/identity has one, else render the first letter on tinted glass - never ship a raster portrait; the existing raster is permitted only for the brand logo (HelpoTron_logo.jpeg / logos_help/). For identity avatars (3.6.3/3.6.5) the same line-art family applies (per-identity accent orbs), sized 40px in chat header / mini in the pill.
notes: Canonical design source = improvement.md (617 lines, the authoritative spec: per-screen requirements, token lists, WCAG/44px, honest-lanes rules) + luminous_glass/DESIGN.md (token values, typography, glass recipe, M3 architecture). Exports are VISUAL references: static, no JS, one theme per file.

Class-name compatibility: export color vocabulary (M3 role names + sem-8-pair names) matches the product's index.css @theme inline almost one-to-one (verified in web/src/index.css); spacing (unit-*/micro-*), page scaffold (max-w-page-max, no .page-pad/.page-max utility yet) and 4 mono font-role names (chip-status, tabular-stat-md/-lg, display-xl-mobile) are export-only and need small alias/token additions for verbatim reuse.

Token VALUES: adopt the product's --st-* per-theme variables (they match DESIGN.md: background #0e1113, primary-container #005049; primary #59d8c9) - never the export's inlined dark-only hex map (primary drifts to #78f5e5, code-sm 11 vs product 13px).

Radii gap: sampled exports (3.4.1, 3.11.2, insights_analytics, 3.1.1, 3.6.1) use only rounded-sm..xl; DESIGN.md's rounded-3xl/2xl panel/card scale must be re-applied at port time; Spec 1.4/touch radii (44px targets, 48px bars, 16px inputs) are spec requirements, not export deltas.

Icons: 2608 Material Symbols glyph spans in exports - convert to lucide-react per spec; illustrations (empty states/heroes/success) come from the curved-stroke line-art family; helpotron_os_logo/code.html SVG is the ready canonical logo asset (stroked, transparent, teal).

The 3.18.1 light settings + 3.3.1 light landing are the only light-palette exports; both are static renders - light theme design must be ported to product data-theme (tokens already registered), verified per-screen (spec 2.7), not copied as 'class=dark' pages.
Chart contract: never swap visx; restyle with existing chart-1..5/--chart-line-primary/--chart-grid/M3 tooltip vars already wired in index.css. Export chart markup is decorative only.

Export has no interactive/behavior code at all (only tailwind config script): focus traps, drag-snap sheets, aria-live, skeletons, error/empty/loading frames, demo ribbon and reduced-motion kills are 100% implementation work defined in spec 2.6-2.7, with accepted patterns being the export's painted states.
